episodes.title: 28 Milioni di Spettatori
episodes.summary: While Enzo Tortora questions whether to continue his hugely popular TV show, Giovanni Pandico faces a series of betrayals in jail.

episodes.title: Galera
episodes.summary: After his very public arrest, Enzo watches from his prison cell as the accusations against him snowball and the media frenzy intensifies.

episodes.title: Infallibili
episodes.summary: While a deteriorating Enzo gets a rare visit with his daughters, Judge Fontana prepares his case against the Camorra.

episodes.title: La colonna infame
episodes.summary: After being granted house arrest due to his heart condition, Enzo is offered an unlikely avenue forward.

episodes.title: Trafficante di morte
episodes.summary: As the trial begins in Naples, Enzo tries to defend himself amid contradicting testimonies from former Camorra members.

episodes.title: Dove eravamo rimasti?
episodes.summary: In advance of the appeal, new judge Michele Morello reexamines the evidence and uncovers troubling errors, omissions, and special treatment given to former Camorra members. Drained by their years-long ordeal, Enzo and his family await the final verdict.
